$comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change the comic. Each panel is regenerated independently by scripts/generate.py. Keep `character_ref` on every panel — it is the consistency anchor. `status` is managed by the scripts: pending -> queued -> done/failed.

defaults.style_suffix: anime cel-shaded manga panel, clean line art, K-pop MV aesthetic, neon backlight, cinematic lighting
defaults.negative: extra fingers, deformed hands, inconsistent hair color, changed outfit, text artifacts, watermark

panels.action: LUNA stands alone at the center of a darkened stage, backlit by a single cold spotlight, ponytail still
panels.caption: 準備好了嗎？

panels.action: she lifts her chin and opens her eyes as the stage lights snap on behind her
panels.caption: 下一個舞台，交給我吧。

panels.action: hair flip as the beat drops, chains on her skirt swinging, neon violet rim light
walking through a neon-lit city street at night, reflections in wet asphalt
she turns toward a giant holographic billboard showing her own face
the hologram glitches and fragments; she reaches a hand toward it
panels.caption: 那真的是我嗎？

panels.action: she clenches her fist, resolve returning, violet light gathering around her

panels.camera: full body splash, dynamic low angle
panels.action: mid-dance pose pointing directly at camera, ponytail whipping, explosion of neon particles and stage lights behind her
panels.caption: LIVE AI

panels.action: winking at the camera with a peace sign, sparkle effect
seen from behind facing a roaring crowd of glowing light sticks
quiet moment backstage, warm dim light, she catches her breath and smiles to herself
walking back toward the stage light, silhouetted in the doorway, long shadow behind her

panels.camera: extreme close-up on eyes, then pull to full body
panels.action: final hero pose under a single beam, CSFCCA logo light flare
panels.caption: See you on the next stage.
